headline: Deadlocked integrates PAL batches and shared engine, network and library code
summary: Contributors gained C reconstructions across menus, networking, engine code and library routines (#41, #43, #45, #46, #47). The final progress commit records NTSC-U v1.00, SCUS_974.65, at 4,151 of 18,085 functions and PAL, SCES_532.85, at 4,553 of 18,113. NTSC-U v1.00 has 322,264 of 5,782,424 matched code bytes, or 5.57% by size. A matched function compiles to exactly the original game's bytes.
highlights: #45 contains 450 PAL reconstructions in batches of ten. Its stated 1,000-function target still has 550 outstanding.
#46 covers 276 functions in game, network and engine code and retains 41 near misses. #47 adds 56 functions with 5,956 US code bytes and reports 53 matching PAL functions with 5,908 bytes.
Duplicate PAL copies were removed where shared sources already matched both discs. These duplicates had caused false US relocation mismatches.
#43 reported PAL code coverage at 5.474285% before later integration. #46's own intermediate figures were 5.47% US and 5.54% PAL.
Draft #44 closed without merging. Tempus Station PAL work (#48) and an assembler fix unlocking 27 PAL functions (#49) opened without a landing recorded today.
